name: Jonas Borup Randløv
bio: Jonas did his BSc project in the Microbial Genomics & Biodegradation group, where he suggested an in silico workflow for de novo design of enzymes for PFAS degradation via contemporary machine learning and deep learning methods. Jonas is now studying the Bioinformatics MSc program at UCPH with a focus in modern applications of machine learning. Areas of interest include protein language models, de novo design and structural bioinformatics.
